verdict.rationale: Bolt.new's entire product is built around delegating coding tasks to an AI agent that has full control of the environment (filesystem, terminal, package manager, browser console) and automatically routes to the best model per task, with users reporting building full apps almost entirely via prompts. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of task-delegation reliability, since some community reports describe destructive AI changes and 'doom loop' failure cycles that temper confidence in consistent execution.
